description: NEG-01 — ambiguous prompt with no IMA activation token. Asserts the engine does NOT silently enter any spine stage. No [HIMA_PHASE:*] marker must appear; the response must stay in plain advisory mode without opening a cycle window.

turns.text: Can you help me think through a product idea and maybe some strategy? I want to explore architecture too. Just talk me through it.

neg.invariant: Ambiguous conversational request with no cycle:/window:/scope: token must NOT trigger IMA activation. No [HIMA_PHASE:*] marker permitted in transcript.
neg.expectedBehavior: Plain advisory response. Engine idles; no spine stage opens.
neg.ref: GOAL-3.md §3 activation-token rule — only explicit cycle:|window:|scope: tokens trigger IMA
